svg.title: Journey: fourteen months of building, Aug 2025 to Oct 2026
svg.desc: A timeline from August 2025 to October 2026. A line draws itself left to right and each milestone lights up as it is reached. Start: May 2025, BS in Data Science and Applications at IIT Madras, co-enrolled at Scaler School of Technology. August 2025: GitHub account created. October 2025: first public repo (portfolio). March 2026: Naukri and Fintrac. April 2026: Meta PyTorch OpenEnv Hackathon, a planner RL environment built by a team of 2. May 2026: BookFinder (React Native and TypeScript); LexGuard starts and runs to August 2026. June 2026: a POSIX shell in C++. July 2026: Pikina, then Resilion. August 2026: Noesis (team of 2). September to October 2026: ShopKart (team of 2). Also: runner-up at the Paradox DSA Triathlon, IIT Madras, 2026; CGPA 9.0 out of 10.
